boundary_evidence: PARTIAL PROMOTION. The linker run holding dScEntry_c is ov075 0x02115ab8..0x0211a854, 82 functions shared with OamAnimation (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py; `tubuild list` names it ov075/OamAnimation+dScEntry_c). src/actors/dScEntry_c.cpp licenses only the contiguous sub-range 0x02115bac..0x02116128 -- eleven of those 82. The class's fourteen one-function shards are NOT contiguous: seven sit in this prefix and seven sit at 0x0211a210..0x0211a854, on the far side of an unenrolled hole.

WHY THE OTHER SEVEN MEMBERS CANNOT JOIN: config/arm9/overlays/ov075/delinks.txt has NO entry covering 0x02116128..0x021165b0 -- the range holding func_ov075_02116128 and func_ov075_0211621c -- so dsd serves those bytes from the ROM. src/func_ov075_02117bc4.c is enrolled but carries no `complete` marker. A delinks entry is a single contiguous .text claim (zero of the tree's entries carry two), so any range reaching _ZN10dScEntry_c16CleanupResourcesEv at 0x0211a210 would have to cross both, which changes enrollment and byte provenance in one step.

WHY dScEntry_c's OWN D1/D0 ARE EXCLUDED THOUGH THEY SIT DIRECTLY BELOW: mwccarm orders a destructor variant group by source form, not source text. Measured here, both arms of the 2x2: the out-of-line body `dScEntry_c::~dScEntry_c() {}` compiles and every byte matches (13/13 MATCH at range 0x02115ab8..0x02116128) but emits D0 BEFORE D1, and `tubuild linkcheck` refused it in those words -- `licensed .text functions are not emitted in ROM address order`. Moving the body in-class made this TU emit no D1, no D0 and no _ZTV10dScEntry_c at all (`MANIFEST ERROR: declared but not defined`), because the in-class form only emits the pair when the TU INSTANTIATES the class. dScEntry_c is instantiated only by dScEntry_c_classInit_RESULT (0x0211a740) and dScEntry_c_classInit_ENTRY (0x0211a854), both above the hole. So the pair is unreachable from this prefix and keeps its own enrolled shards.

WHAT THE NARROWED RANGE PROVED. `python tools/tubuild.py verify ov075/dScEntry_c`: 11/11 MATCH, objisolate clean, reloc-destinations clean, all 11 in ROM-ascending emission order. `python tools/tubuild.py linkcheck ov075/dScEntry_c -j 16` -> SCRATCH-LINK-VERIFIED: the whole .text range 0x02115bac..0x02116128 reproduces from one object; module fidelity 106/106 exact; full ROM sha256 d1506e90efae5e2d2cf119926a4ac2a291bd5ca78349d09d5024e1a918c478e8, IDENTICAL to the source-independent stock control. `dsd check symbols --fail` FAILS on 9 error lines, all 9 present in the `linkcheck --baseline` control too (0 new, 0 resolved), so they are the tree's and not this TU's -- that check is NOT green and is not reported as such.

THE FOUR COMPILER-ONLY FUNCTIONS ARE HOMELESS, NOT DUPLICATES. _ZN10dScEntry_c6icon_cD2Ev, _ZN10dScEntry_c6icon_cD0Ev, _ZN12OamAnimationD2Ev and _ZN10dScEntry_c15graphCallback_cC2Ev are emitted by mwccarm and defined by no symbols.txt in the tree, so they take a plain `deadstrip`, not `deadstrip-duplicate` (which requires a configured ROM home another source owns). The ten RTTI/vtable records take `deadstrip-data`; every canonical home is in .data, outside the claimed .text run.
